stories.title: Hundreds could be hit by chemotherapy scandal, trust says
stories.summary: Becky Jones says chemotherapy had been "dished out like it was sweets" to patients like her.

stories.title: Investigation into rape of man at skate park over
stories.summary: West Mercia Police says it takes "all reports of rape and sexual offences extremely seriously".

stories.title: No main Christmas lights switch-on 'embarrassing'
stories.summary: A former mayor says it is "embarrassing" for Worcester to have no main Christmas lights switch-on.

stories.title: Police ordered to attend inquest into young mother's death
stories.summary: West Mercia Police is reviewing how it investigated the death of Tasha Ashby in 2023.

stories.title: Wild swimmers bare all for 2027 charity calendar
stories.summary: The calendar has been created by members of the Broadfields swimming group in Worcestershire.

stories.title: Worcester Warriors mementos fund dementia cafes
stories.summary: Vintage Warriors shirts, scarves and kit are being sold to support outlets in Worcestershire.

stories.title: Police interview fatal bin lorry crash driver
stories.summary: The 51-year-old spoke to officers voluntarily a year after the collision with a Leominster building.

stories.title: 'Flying doctor saved my sight after dogs attacked me'
stories.summary: Colwall woman whose sight was saved by a Midlands Air Ambulance doctor is backing calls for funding to ensure a doctor is on every flight.

stories.title: Movember maypole dancing for men's health
stories.summary: The event which aims to "get more men talking about men's health" raises more than £6,300 for charities.

stories.title: Police officer charged with sex offences
stories.summary: James Preece, 39, is accused of two counts of sexual assault, allegedly committed in December 2022.

stories.title: Opener Lategan signs Worcestershire deal extension
stories.summary: Worcestershire opening bat Daniel Lategan signs a three-year contract extension to run to the end of the 2029 season.

stories.title: Two charged after man hurt in flag-related disorder
stories.summary: Ryan Bridge and Mark Keating are charged over the disorder, which broke out in Stirchley in May.
